title: NVIDIA's CEO Resignation: What It Means for Your AI Infrastructure Roadmap
description:
NVIDIA’s CEO has stepped down, and we’re breaking down what this means for the hardware powering your AI tools. Plus, we look at the new 'half-life' of AI models to see if your current tech stack is already on the clock.

What we covered:
• NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang resigns amid scandal; CFO Colette Kress named interim CEO
• Google launches 'Intelligent Eyewear' Android XR glasses
• Meta launches Muse AI assistant for smartwatches

Three distinct AI stories, with lively debate, useful discoveries and practical takeaways.

Listener question: When you see AI companies launching new hardware or models, do you feel more excited by the progress or exhausted by the pace?

What to watch tomorrow: not which AI headline was loudest, but which one quietly changed the rules.

Alex, Jamie and Rufus tell you what changed in AI, who wins, and what you do next.

What changed. Who wins. What you do next.
